objective: First visit to the Parallel World. A small early automation becomes visible there as a modest glowing structure. Establish the core visual rule: real-world systems generate parallel-world architecture — and that failures don't vanish, they become luminous ruins marked on the map.

scenes.description: The Traveler and NØVA building, hands-on
scenes.visuals: Small workshop scene, The Traveler and NØVA working together over a modest glowing panel — an early automation being wired

scenes.description: First reveal of the Parallel World
scenes.visuals: The small system lifts off the workbench and rises into the Parallel World as a modest glowing structure — first full establishing shot of the geometric city
scenes.copy: El primer sistema real se levanta como una pequeña estructura, en un mundo que apenas empieza a formarse.

scenes.description: NØVA asks if this is Opsly
scenes.visuals: NØVA circling the small structure, curious, The Traveler watching
scenes.copy: NØVA — "¿Eso es Opsly?" The Traveler — "No. Pero creo que es una pieza."

scenes.visuals: A second, larger structure attempt collapses into dim, fractured light — it doesn't disappear, it settles into the ground as a marked ruin
scenes.copy: No todo funciona. Un sistema falla — y no desaparece.

scenes.visuals: NØVA looking at the dim ruin, The Traveler beside him
scenes.copy: NØVA — "¿Fallamos?" The Traveler — "Sí." NØVA — "¿Entonces la borramos?" The Traveler — "No. Ahora sabemos por dónde no pasar."

metadata.call_to_action: Cada sistema real construye un mundo.

captions.es: El primer sistema, apenas una chispa.
captions.en: The first system, barely a spark.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: A small glowing structure rising in the Parallel World, The Traveler and NØVA watching it form

notes: Act III of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.
Theme: small, unglamorous beginnings are still real beginnings; failure leaves information instead of disappearing.
Visual motif: LUMINOUS RUINS (canon device, see ../../canon/SYMBOLS.md) — introduced here, paid off at the cipher reveal in Episode 12.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 03.
